key_insight: Claw-Eval-Live introduces a live, refreshable benchmarking design that evaluates LLM agents on end-to-end, real-world workflows and verifiable execution signals rather than static final responses. This enables continuous, real-world–aligned assessment as workflow demands evolve.
problem_solved: Static, frozen benchmarks fail to capture evolving workflow demands and often only grade final outputs, making it hard to verify whether agents actually executed tasks or can adapt to changing real-world tool/service environments.
method: Design a live benchmark that separates a refreshable 'signal layer' (updated across releases) from public workflow demand, allowing evaluation signals to evolve without changing task definitions.
Execute agents against real software tools, business services, and local workspaces to capture end-to-end behavior and generate verifiable execution traces.
Automated verification and scoring that checks execution correctness and updates leaderboards continuously as signals and workflows change.
impact: Provides practitioners a practical way to measure agent reliability, adaptivity, and real-world execution correctness over time, improving deployment readiness and trustworthiness of LLM agents in production workflows.
visual_elements: System architecture diagram: agent ↔ tools/services ↔ refreshable signal layer illustrating separation and data flow
Timeline or carousel showing evolving workflow demands and periodic signal layer updates (continuous evaluation)
Execution flowchart: task specification → agent actions → verifiable signals → automated scoring
Live leaderboard / heatmap mockup showing metric changes as signals and agent versions evolve
paper_title: Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
paper_authors: Chenxin Li, Zhengyang Tang, Huangxin Lin, Yunlong Lin, Shijue Huang
